[b]Howdy Outlaws![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44783696/117329e7acefbc422b25aee513972859f7a1434c.png[/img]

About a month and a half ago, we started the Community Bullet Contest. Now, after lots of suggesting, picking out, drawing and programming, we present: the Community Bullet Contest Winners!

Dice Bullet:

Suggested by user “hiverakani_kiv_empor”, this Bullet throws the dice whenever it is drawn. The original suggested name for this Bullet was ”Mystery Bullet”, but was changed for flavor reasons.

Excalibullet: suggested by user “killgorndigrogen”. Gets stronger, the more unique cards are in your stack. The effect was changed slightly to allow for more synergies. Hopefully it isn't stuck in a stone…

The third bullet was suggested by user “kengored” and can be responsible for alot of mischief, thats all im gonna say…

4 additional Bullets from the Community Bullet Contest will find its way into the game at a later date. Thank you all for participating! It was the first time we did something like this, so if you have feedback be sure to let us know. It was so cool to see what you all came up with and the collected effort to bring some of the other community bullets to life with a mod was just awsome!

We are still actively working on the update, but here is a small teaser :)

notes.title: Community Bullet Contest
notes.notes:
[h1]Community Bullet Contest[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44783696/c0edb0cef64a529b5e761511c84028d1440d4b63.png[/img]

[b]Howdy Outlaws! [/b]

It’s now been a few months since Forty-Five was released. Many of you have been playing the game daily, and some of you have even taken to making your own content for the game. As such, we thought it’d be cool to give you the chance to have your ideas officially added into the game! 

We have decided to hold a community contest that’ll give you the chance to leave your permanent mark on Forty-Five. Starting today, the 2nd of October, you will have 7 days, up until the 9th of October, to submit your bullet ideas to the designated discord channel. At the end of the 7 days, we will select some of our favorites and create a community poll to select a winner. The development team will also separately vote for a bullet that will be implemented into the game alongside the poll winner. 

Every community member can submit up to 3 different bullet ideas. The submissions should include a name for the bullet, as well as any special effects it has. You may also add a sketch of the bullet. 

Once again thank you for your continued support, we cannot wait to see what you come up with!

[b]Summary:[/b]
•    Starts on  date and ends on  date
•    3 bullet ideas per person
•    Submit to the designated discord channel
•    Submission must include bullet name, and effects
•    Sketches may be added to submissions. 
•    keep in mind, that all bullets are subject to change

Here is the link to join our discord server:
https://discord.gg/aeJbJyECDd

[h2]Mod showcase[/h2]
The Discord user with the name Sengee has created a modpack that you can download and find on our discord server! Its a mod that allows bullets to only be obtained through the shop, making the game significantly more challenging. It also includes a collection of 7 well-thought-of bullets for anyone who's looking for new bullets, while waiting for the next big update of .Forty-Five. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44783696/0436af9a303042acfbff53e9f246894030a66f22.png[/img]


We're really excited to see what you come up with!
[b]See you in the frontier![/b]

notes.title: .FORTY-FIVE Bullet-in 2
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44783696/e5f17f3665ace879628603f63be9e42a8ddb6339.png[/img]

[b]Howdy Outlaws![/b]

[h2]On the new Update[/h2]

We have good news, we are in fact not dead! Over the past few months we have been busy working on a new major update for the game. Sadly, this update will remain in development for a few more months and we won’t announce a release date yet, but we are working hard to get it out as soon as possible. To give you a better idea on why it’s taking so long, here is a short list of changes the new update will bring:

[list]
[*] a complete revamp of some internal systems, improving the performce of the significantly and making the ui less glitchy
[*] a new biome!
[*] a new enemy type
[*] new map generation
[*] a collection ui, showing you which cards you already collected, in this and previous runs
[*] a complete rebalancing of the game
[*] major changes to encounter gameplay (that we won’t spoil yet)
[*] a [i]bunch[/i] of new cards, encounter modifiers and effects
[/list]

As we approach the release of this update, there will be a spoiler season where we show some of the new cards, encounter modifiers and other teasers. Here are little hints we have posted in our discord server before:

[list]
[*] There is a bullet that was not created digitally.
[*] There is at least one bullet which doesn't feature the word "Bullet" in its name
[*] There is a bullet which is named after and looks like something that can be seen on the map in the bewitched forest
[*] Flavortext: ”Im sorry to everyone with …....... . Though, if I had that, i probably wouldn’t look at that hairy thing just to read an apology. Ew”
[*] Flavortext: ”Dead or alive. In our case dead tho, no reserves if he is still breathing.”
[*] A statuseffect which implements an existing encounter modifier on a temporary basis
[*] An encounter modifier named "Confused"
[*] The new enemy has a attack "Heads up - or rather down"
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44783696/ef6191eb1296481919ac8d4c23dd280d6662ab6c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44783696/d086d055c930a7056e530f4358a71f8abb9c7e4a.png[/img]

This update is quite ambitious, and we are happy to say that most of the above features are actually implemented already! But the adding the remaining features, and most importantly, testing them and making sure they work like we want them to, will still take some time. In addition, we are a quite small team of five people working on this as a hobby, so our time is unfortunately limitet. But on that note: 

[h2]The .Forty-Five team got help![/h2]

A discord user called @nutellacroissant recently joined us! He is a screenwriter and is helping us out with some of the flavourtexts and dialogs in the game. This will hopefully deepen the lore of the game and reduce the amount of spelling mistakes / weird grammar. If you can help us out with some aspect of the game and are willing to donate some of your time, fell free to message us on Discord!

[b]Thats it for today, we hope you are as exited for this update as we are! See you in the frontier![/b]

notes.title: Weekly Update
notes.notes:
[b]Howdy Outlaws![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44783696/3eedfaca2f34c2856f8e149ccd1c7d2218ff4aa4.png[/img]

This week's update adds a new NPC to the game. You can find him in Salem and he might spill some interesting tea...

Additionally, we are adding two new bullets, which were inspired by some ideas from "LeEpicH" on the Discord.

Broken Arrow is... well, it's a broken arrow. What more can I say about it? I guess two arrows are better than one tho, even if one is broken...

The second bullet definitely goes well with those arrows, whether they are broken or not!

This update also brings a change to DISINTEGRATION. To help your memory a little bit, bullets with disintegration loose 1 dmg on rotate. With this update, they will also destroy themselves once they have 0 damage left. It's a small change, but it opens up some possibilities with destroy and further reinforces the mindset of having to strategically place your bullets to prevent them from dying. However, the mystery bullet might just be the perfect bullet to not only keep the disintegration bullets alive, but also strengthen them in the process. If you have two, that is...

As always, we will monitor this change. Let us know what you think about it!

[h2]Whats Next?[/h2]

Unfortunately, in preparation for the first major update, we have decided to suspend the regular weekly updates for now to focus on developing new features. However, this doesn't mean there won't be any smaller updates; they just won’t be on a regular basis. Leading up to the release of the big update, we will share more information with you through a .Forty-five Bulletin, where we discuss changes and new additions. We hope you understand, making the weekly updates slowed down the development a lot. However, there still will be small updates that might add NPCs, teasers, or a bullet here and there; they just won’t be regular. We will announce on our discord when the next update drops; you can join it [url=https://discord.gg/2caBPyXK9B]here[/url].

Also, we have a lot of new bullets and mechanics planned for the big updates, so don't worry, you won't run out of firepower anytime soon :)

We hope you understand our decision, and we look forward to seeing you in the Frontier.

notes.title: Weekly Update
notes.notes:
[b]Howdy Outlaws![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44783696/cbcf630e98d04835a91c0f9e0d047c8a0e4d78a1.png[/img]

This week's update introduces two new bullets. The Doodle Bullet is designed to provide support for all those 0 cost bullets and introduces a new keyword: SEARCH. For those familiar with card game terminology, SEARCH is used as a tutor. As the name suggests, it searches for a card in your deck, meeting a certain requirement. In the case of Doodle Bullet, it searches for a random bullet in your deck that costs 0 reserves, buffing it in the process. 

By the way, Doodle Bullet was doodled in Sardinia, on a trip, in a car, with my laptop. So, if that's not a flavor win, I don't know what is. Because that's the cool thing about doodling; it doesn't matter the age, skill, place, or equipment, everyone can doodle.

[h3]Whats next[/h3]

We are currently testing early versions of some new features; however, it will still take a while to bring them to a place where they are release-ready. If you have gathered some of the clues during the weekly updates, you might already have an idea of some of the things coming… 

[b]See you in the Frontier![/b]

[b]Howdy Outlaws![/b]

This weeks update brings Backup and the possibility to disable time-based encounter modifiers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44783696/5b1f22d202711a6a618751a683aed2df0300362f.png[/img]

Backup Bullet does exactly what its name suggests. It provides backup in times where it's needed the most.

Speaking of times, we have added the option to disable real-time-based encounter modifiers.

We understand that a lot of people don’t want real-time elements in their turn-based game. However, there are also a lot of people who like the added challenge that comes with the time limit. So the team decided that adding an option to disable it would be the best solution.

If you don’t like time these mechanics, you can now go to the settings and set “Realtime based mechanics” to “disabled”.

notes.title: Weekly Update
notes.notes:
[b]Howdy Outlaws![/b]

This weeks update brings a new bullet and a change to goldiggers bullet.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44783696/d31876b612fdeb0919b92499c90b1b7413cd4d65.png[/img]

As some of you might have noticed, over the last two weeks or so, there was a bit of a gold rush happening in the frontier. More specifically a combo, which uses Goldiggers Bullet and the different cards that draw cards to create an infinite combo.

[h2]Goldiggers Change & the new bullet[/h2]

Over the span of the last week we thought a lot about what to do with the "Goldrush Combo".

Here is what we came up with: 

Golddiggers Bullet will now only give reserves when two or more cards are drawn. The player gains half as many reserves as the number of cards drawn, rounded down.

This means, that placing Silver Bullet won’t give you reserves anymore, however for example placing Diamond Bullet will give you 1 reserve. 

To not completely kill the goldrush combo, we are introducing a new card in order to keep the gold rush going but making it a liiiiiiittle bit harder to achieve. This card is Wealthy Bullet: It lets you draw one additional card every time a card draw event is triggered.

[h2]About infinite combos[/h2]

We are by no means opposed to infinite combos, in fact we think it is one of the most fun things in the game to find new ways to break it. However, these game breaking combos should take a little bit of effort, reserves and planning. This was not the case with the old gold rush combo which is why we nerfed Golddiggers Bullet and then introduced Wealthy Bullet. 

We hope we could provide y’all with a little inside in our thought process. We will monitor how this affects the game, and, till then, let us know your thoughts!

[h2]Other Changes:[/h2]

[list]
[*] fixed a Bug involving eclipse Bullet (a little bit too late for the real eclipse…) (and thanks to @Alex-x90 for reporting it!)
[*] Because we noticed that a lot of players had trouble understanding how shield works, we now introduced a little animation to hopefully communicate it better
[*] The text in the tutorial is now somewhat improved
[*] Burning had a similar problem, where a lot of players didn't really understand how it affects the game. This is now improved by displaying the additional damage of the burning effect above the enemy.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44783696/57b7b0c0fc5ea64852bbb5c790e975c0b9be7941.png[/img]

[h2]Whats next[/h2]

We are still hard at work rebalancing the game. Also, there are some cool things coming we won't spoil yet ;)

[b]See you in the frontier![/b]

notes.title: Roadmap & Future Plans
notes.notes:
[b]Howdy Outlaws![/b]

Welcome to the first issue of the “.Forty-Five Bullet-in”!

This is our way to communicate with you, the players, in order to give insights into the development process, share behind the scenes content and announce whats to come.

As you may have noticed playing the game, we are not 100% finished yet. We decided to release anyway, mainly to gather feedback. But that also means that there is still a lot of work ahead of us, which is why we are presenting our plans for the game in this issue of the “.Forty-Five Bullet-in”.

[h2]Roadmap[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44783696/aeb95a7122f77e477102b5858252aa3c6e52fcb2.png[/img]

[h2]Weekly Content Updates[/h2]

In order to keep the game interesting, we want to provide (hopefully) weekly content updates including new bullets, new effects, new insights into the story of .Forty-Five or even new enemy types.

Here is a little sneak peek of what's coming sometime soon…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44783696/dd99b3811854ff64fd42de30f41b4bfde187a53f.png[/img]

[h2]Quality of Life Updates & Bug Fixes[/h2]

We’ve already received a lot of feedback from you guys and the first patch with some small bug fixes is already live! We are planning to add a lot of quality of live improvements and will continue to fix every bug we can find, without creating tooooo many new ones.

We’ve also decided to rework the tutorial to prioritize short and visual learnig over just pressing “okay” on an endless wall of text. The tutorial is the first interaction the player has with the game, so we want it to really be short, informative and sweet. Also, we know half of you aren’t reading the tutorial anyways ;)

[h2]Big Content Updates[/h2]

In the background, we will be working on some bigger updates like new biomes or the missing areas. We’ve also brainstomed some new archetypes, so there are more ways for you to … shoot things. Also we are aware of the current issues with the progression of the game and want to rework the game loop so it feels more like a true roguelite.

[b]We hope you are as excited for these plans as we are. Till then, let us know your thoughts and see you in the frontier![/b]

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Behind the Scenes[/h2]

Also, speaking of balancing… We don’t get the issue, the game is [i]peeeerfectly[/i] balanced...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44783696/2f2c2077ee4205ac8e78c65066f368aa644fbb74.png[/img]

For context, we used to have an encounter modifier called lookalike, which would create a copy of a card every time it was placed in the revolver. As you can see, we quickly realised that it had some issues…

notes.title: .Forty-Five is out now!
notes.notes:
[h2]Howdy outlaws![/h2]

Two years ago, we had the idea of a deckbuilding card game set in the wild west. A lot of tears, sweat, and what feels like 1000 meetings later, it is finally time to open the gates to the frontier!

https://youtu.be/tHcUkfya7nE

.Forty-five was developed as a diploma thesis by 5 students from the Higher Technical School "HTL Rennweg" in Vienna, Austria. Now that the diploma thesis is complete, we can finally release our game. 

Please note that the game is not 100% finished yet and that we would like to rework some aspects of the game that don’t work well yet. However, we still wanted to release, mainly to gather usefull feedback.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44783696/e73775505479ae935dbcfdbde6306bf02fb6e6a4.png[/img]

[h2]What's next?[/h2]

For us, this launch is just the beginning.  We've got a lot of things planned and we are thrilled to share them with you. So, keep your eyes peeled for the first issue of the ".Forty-Five Bullet-in", where we share insights on the future of the game.

It will include a developer blog, behind-the-scenes content, updates on what we're working on, and other information.

If, however, you are tired of waiting for us to release the next update and you perhaps have some coding skills, I have good news:

[h2]Open Source:[/h2]

Yes, thats right! The source code of .Forty-Five is [url=https://github.com/blueUserRed/forty-five]public[/url] under the GPLv3 license. That means that anyone is free to view and share the code of the game. Also, everyone can make their own modified versions of our game and redistribute it, as long as they maintain the GPLv3.0 license. Contributions are also welcome!

Beware of ugly code tho :>


We would also like to express our gratitude to everyone who supported us along the way <3. It's incredible to finally see our project released to the public, and we are looking forward to everyone's thoughts and feedback!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2691350/FortyFive/
